what: ggsmatr: Example using the iris dataset
title: ggsmatr example
text: presence fitted SMA lines ggplot2 scatter plot can obtained object created smatr::sma(). first read example data included package fit common-slope SMA group.
code: datafile <- system.file("iris.csv", package = "ggsmatr") df.iris <- read.csv(datafile, encoding = "UTF-8")  fit <- sma(   Sepal.Length ~ Sepal.Width + Species,   data = df.iris,   shift = TRUE,   elev.test = TRUE,   alpha = 0.05 ) ggsmatr(   data = df.iris,   groups = "Species",   xvar = "Sepal.Width",   yvar = "Sepal.Length",   sma.fit = fit ) +   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank()) +   ylab("Sepal.Length") +   xlab("Sepal.Width") #>        group    r2  pval #> 1     setosa 0.551 0.000 #> 2 versicolor 0.277 0.000 #> 3  virginica 0.209 0.001 #> Warning: Using `size` aesthetic for lines was deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0. #> ℹ Please use `linewidth` instead. #> ℹ The deprecated feature was likely used in the ggsmatr package. #>   Please report the issue to the authors. #> This warning is displayed once per session. #> Call `lifecycle::last_lifecycle_warnings()` to see where this warning was #> generated.

title: ggsmatr example
text: Given SMA lines pass group centroid, presence parametric confidence ribbon can added ci = TRUE. ribbon uses slope confidence intervals already stored sma() fit (Slope_lowCI Slope_highCI), related OLS band geom_smooth(). confidence level one used model fitted, example sma(..., alpha = 0.05) 95% intervals.  Transparency smoothness ribbon can controlled ci.alpha n:
code: ggsmatr(   data = df.iris,   groups = "Species",   xvar = "Sepal.Width",   yvar = "Sepal.Length",   sma.fit = fit,   ci = TRUE ) +   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank()) +   ylab("Sepal.Length") +   xlab("Sepal.Width") #>        group    r2  pval Slope Slope_lowCI Slope_highCI #> 1     setosa 0.551 0.000 0.930       0.767        1.128 #> 2 versicolor 0.277 0.000 1.645       1.288        2.100 #> 3  virginica 0.209 0.001 1.972       1.527        2.545 ggsmatr(   data = df.iris,   groups = "Species",   xvar = "Sepal.Width",   yvar = "Sepal.Length",   sma.fit = fit,   ci = TRUE,   ci.alpha = 0.15,   n = 150 )

title: ggsmatr 'ggplot2' based SMATR plots — ggsmatr
text: data dataframe. groups group variable. xvar x variable drawing. yvar y variable drawing. sma.fit sma ma object fitted SMATR package. ci logical. TRUE, add parametric confidence ribbon SMA slope, using slope confidence intervals stored sma.fit (set level sma(..., alpha = )). Given SMA lines pass group centroid, ribbon slope-CI envelope pivoted group mean, related OLS band geom_smooth(). Default FALSE. ci.alpha Alpha transparency passed ggplot2::geom_ribbon(). Default 0.2. n Number x values confidence ribbon evaluated group. Default 100.

title: ggsmatr 'ggplot2' based SMATR plots — ggsmatr
code: datafile <- system.file("iris.csv", package = "ggsmatr") df.iris <- read.csv(datafile, encoding = "UTF-8")  library(ggsmatr) library(ggplot2) library(smatr) #> Warning: package 'smatr' was built under R version 4.6.1 fit <- sma(Sepal.Length ~ Sepal.Width + Species,            data = df.iris, shift = TRUE, elev.test = TRUE, alpha = 0.05)  ggsmatr(data = df.iris, groups = "Species",         xvar = "Sepal.Width", yvar = "Sepal.Length",         sma.fit = fit) +   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank()) +   ylab("Sepal.Length") +   xlab("Sepal.Width") #>        group    r2  pval #> 1     setosa 0.551 0.000 #> 2 versicolor 0.277 0.000 #> 3  virginica 0.209 0.001 #> Warning: Using `size` aesthetic for lines was deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0. #> ℹ Please use `linewidth` instead. #> ℹ The deprecated feature was likely used in the ggsmatr package. #>   Please report the issue at #>   <https://github.com/mariosandovalmx/ggsmatr/issues>.   # parametric slope-CI ribbon, using the intervals already stored in the sma fit ggsmatr(data = df.iris, groups = "Species",         xvar = "Sepal.Width", yvar = "Sepal.Length",         sma.fit = fit, ci = TRUE) +   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank()) +   ylab("Sepal.Length") +   xlab("Sepal.Width") #>        group    r2  pval Slope Slope_lowCI Slope_highCI #> 1     setosa 0.551 0.000 0.930       0.767        1.128 #> 2 versicolor 0.277 0.000 1.645       1.288        2.100 #> 3  virginica 0.209 0.001 1.972       1.527        2.545

title: ggsmatr 0.2.0
text: Added optional parametric confidence ribbon ggsmatr() new arguments ci, ci.alpha n. ribbon uses slope confidence intervals already stored sma() fit (Slope_lowCI Slope_highCI) pivoted group centroid. Given SMA lines pass group mean, envelope presents uncertainty slope rather OLS geom_smooth() band. printed summary now includes Slope, Slope_lowCI Slope_highCI ci = TRUE. Documentation, vignette examples updated show presence confidence ribbons grouped SMA plots.
